mentions.name: Multi AI workflow wizard engine
mentions.description: A multi-AI workflow wizard engine: the user provides an initial prompt (e.g. "create a game"), then a series of AI models (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude) prompt themselves in sequence until a finished outcome is produced. The user can edit any intermediate output step so the end result can be tuned along the way.
mentions.source_excerpt:
a multi ai workflow wizard engine

basically a user give an initial prompt ie "create a game" and then a series of ai (gemini, openai, claude) prompt themselves  until a finished outcome. the user can change any output step in between so the end result can be tuned instead at any point
